args.body: Use the committed search-notice-links.json and the existing mission lease. Skip the search refetch. Within the two-original-notice limit, prioritize a current notice that appears to purchase standalone data validation. If the original notice verifies the deadline, eligibility, submission route and a testable acceptance criterion, run the existing checker on one fictional example tied to that criterion. Save the buyer quotation and source hash, exact command and output, and a copy-ready operator response. If neither notice qualifies, save the controlling exclusions and the specific buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Read the committed result before closing with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep advertised value, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. No submission, contact, registration or spending.

description: The official UK Contracts Finder search returned HTTP 200 and produced a committed notice-link extract. That supports screening the saved leads for one paid, standalone data quality job and building a sample only against a verified buyer requirement. Feedback reporting is available and shows no classified commercial signals, with five unclassified sources and uncertain release attribution. Demand remains unknown. Catalogue publication still depends on host-confirmed independent approval of the exact digest. The invoice checkpoint depends on authoritative release and cutoff evidence. Verified funds available and verified revenue are both zero.
